row.notes: Walks the 0x18-byte tier vector at table+8..+0x10 backwards to the first tier whose float threshold at +0x10 is >= fraction. For result[2] (session kind) < 2 returns the tier's int array (tier+8 -> +8) indexed by result[0] (position); for kinds 0, 1, 5 adds the tier bonus int at +4 when the tier type byte is 1 or 2, result[1]==0 and position < 10. Looks like championship points scaled by completed race distance plus a top-10 bonus; hook to change points awarded.
